detail.longDescription: Hi HN. I would love to show you beta preview of Topics. Articles on the internet are organized by source (publications, social media, personal websites), by recency, or by position in search. I believe it’s nicer for the reader if articles are organized by Topics. Topics solve problem of decision fatigue, omnipresent AI slop, and people stopping to trust writing on internet and stopping to read. I'm grateful for any feedback you might have. TOpics app is launching soon. X: @topics_official.
